programme.desc: January 20th, 1992 - Flight 148 starts its descent towards Strasbourg airport. An Airbus A-320 is the world's first fully computerised passenger plane, and while its autopilot is programmed to land on a specific runway, high winds mean the pilots must take over the controls. But things get out of control and the aircraft suddenly slams into the side of a mountain, killing eighty-seven people. Investigators will enquire as to what caused such confusion, but can they unveil what was to blame?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigations
programme.desc: December 19th, 2005 - Flight 101 is preparing for take-off in the waters off Miami Beach, Florida. Part plane, part speedboat, the twin turbo-prop taxis through one of the world's busiest ports, and after a smooth take-off, is suddenly rocked by an explosion. From the beach, a tourist films its catastrophic plunge into the ocean. Lifeguards immediately race to the crash site and within hours, salvage crews begin recovering the wreckage. But what caused such a horrendous mid-air explosion?

programme.title: Juggling's Not Just A Party Trick S2 Ep4

Bec's attempting to do it all - maintain the salon, mediate between Frances and Jenny and her parents - plus the added pressure of a first pregnancy. However, something has to give and her decision about what to let go shocks those closest to her. When Jenny finds out that her Dad's been made redundant, it magnifies her guilt about spending all the lottery money. She decides to take on a new job managing Lachie's band, but will spending even more time with Lachie impact on her relationship with Callum? Guest starring CARMEN DUNCAN, NATALIE SALEEBA, LUKE ARNOLD, MATT LEVETT and MAYA ALEKSANDRA.

programme.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
programme.desc: The innocent looking Dragonfruitflyus has a cheeky habit of mimicking the noises of other Vegesaurs, so when the baby Pea-Rexes catch on they can't help but turn it into a competition.

programme.title: Kangaroo Beach
programme.desc: Gemma can't wait to explore on Snorkelling Day, but her snorkel gets in the way. Frizzy is being distracting while the cadets learn how to stay calm in the water, but in the end, it's Frizzy who teaches Gemma how to relax.

programme.title: Fizzy And Suds
programme.desc: Fizzy and Suds have a wheel-y good time exploring the world of bicycles, from BMX tricks and frame building to the colourful science of spinning wheels and circular motion.

programme.title: HexVets And Magic Pets
programme.desc: When Emilios hurts his wing, Annette feels responsible, and the trainees go on a journey to help.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island
programme.sub-title: Andy Goes Fishing on Dino Island
programme.desc: Jen is studying the undiscovered prehistoric fish that live on Dino Island. Andy offers to go on a fishing adventure to see what new fish he can find and photograph.

programme.title: Play School: Playtime With Pets
programme.desc: Abi and Teo meet a bearded dragon, gidgee skink and a knob-tailed gecko! Abi shows how to slither like a snake, Teo makes a craft blue-tongued lizard pet and Jemima builds a friendly garden for her animal friends to visit.

programme.title: Fireman Sam
programme.desc: Sarah is excited to shadow Sergeant Rose Ravani until she's stuck filing maps. But when Gareth gets lost, Sarah learns how important map reading is.

programme.title: Miffy and Friends
programme.desc: Miffy is excited to make her first artwork from clay, but when Baby Bun wants to make something with her, Miffy is worried that he will ruin it.

programme.title: The Woohoos!
programme.desc: Panda is visiting Wise Island so the Woohoos put together a picnic of their favourite foods for her - but she doesn't like any of it! They discover that they all like different foods, and what Panda likes the most is bamboo.

programme.title: Nikhil & Jay
programme.sub-title: Nikhil and Jay and the Sneezies
programme.desc: When Amma gets the sneezies, Nikhil and Jay are worried that it's Max's fault. They try to stop their cat from being sent away.

programme.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
programme.sub-title: Daniel and Max Ask to Play; Daniel Asks to Play at the Music Shop
programme.desc: At the Music Shop, O the Owl wants to join his friends, but is worried they'll say no. When he asks them if he can play too, that is music to their ears!
